title: Crypto Trading Signals - August 09, 2026
top_story_headline: Brazil's central bank orders exchanges to delay large crypto transfers abroad for up to 24 hours
top_story_comment: Resolution BCB 584 lets exchanges release transfers early after a documented risk review, while even sub-$10,000 withdrawals can be held when flagged. Withdrawal speed becomes a compliance moat: Brazilian PSAVs with better real-time fraud scoring can clear clean flow faster when the rule starts Jan. 1, 2027.
